objective: Test whether Serper Search is a stable, economical source of Google organic controls for the existing Google AI Overview and ChatGPT citation observations.
causal_boundary: This is an instrumentation experiment. It does not publish or edit pages and cannot estimate whether any writing lever changes retrieval, mention, citation, rank, or traffic.

eligibility_preflight.reason: The root serves an install script to command-line clients and redirects browser clients to GitHub; robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404 pages. There is no crawlable owned-page treatment/control pool.
eligibility_preflight.external_mutation: No push, deployment, page edit, or indexing request is authorized or performed.

inputs.query_rule: Deduplicate exact query strings across phases, retain first-seen metadata, then order each wave by SHA-256(protocol_id|wave|query).
inputs.blinding: not used; the user explicitly waived blinding for this large instrumentation dataset

stability: within-Serper top-10 URL Jaccard between waves
within-Serper top-10 domain Jaccard between waves
Serper versus DataForSEO top-10 organic URL and domain Jaccard
ai_join: Google AI Overview citation URL and domain recall in Serper top 10
ChatGPT citation URL and domain recall in Serper top 10
rate of explicit AI-answer or AI-citation fields in Serper responses

decision_rules.operational_pass: success rate >= 0.99, malformed count = 0, and median organic count >= 8
decision_rules.stable_organic_control_pass: operational pass plus median within-Serper URL Jaccard >= 0.70 and median Serper-versus-DataForSEO URL Jaccard >= 0.50
decision_rules.direct_ai_instrument_pass: an explicit AI answer object and its citations are present in every response used for AI scoring
decision_rules.lever_claim: No lever may be promoted, demoted, or called efficient from this experiment because there is no randomized published treatment.

budget.rule: Stop at the preregistered sample; the approved cap is a ceiling, not a spending target. Existing free credits may be used, but no credit purchase is authorized.
